pages.title: Brewery
pages.description: Main build game screen where users construct and upgrade their moonshine brewery and trailer using coins

pages.title: Activities
pages.description: Three mini-games with PLAY NOW buttons and 15-minute cooldowns. All navigate to full game screens: Bass Fishin', Varmint Huntin', Swamp Campin'.

pages.title: Bass Fishin' Game
pages.description: Interactive bass fishing mini-game with SVG gradient sky, tree silhouettes, fish shadows in water, lily pads, seaweed. Cast power meter, bobber bite detection, reaction timing hookset, rapid-tap reel-in. 5 fish types (Bluegill→Trophy Bass) with rarity tiers and coin rewards.

pages.title: Varmint Huntin' Game
pages.description: Interactive hunting mini-game: stalk through dense woods with birds/fog/undergrowth, sight animal, oscillating red crosshair scope, fire when centered, rapid-tap tracking. 5 prey types (Squirrel→8-Point Buck). 15-minute cooldown set after game outcome.

pages.title: Swamp Campin' Game
pages.description: Interactive swamp camping mini-game: pitch tent, power-bar fire-starting, lure critters to the fire, grab them with rapid-tap before they escape. 5 critter types (Bullfrog→Gator). Dark bayou scene with moon, fireflies, gator eyes, cypress trees. 15-minute cooldown.

pages.title: Store
pages.description: In-app purchase screen with coin packages ($0.99–$10.00) wired to Stripe Payment Links. Tapping a package opens a Stripe-hosted checkout page. Requires STRIPE_PAYMENT_LINK in Settings → Environment.

pages.title: Profile
pages.description: User authentication and profile management with progress tracking
pages.suggested_prompt: Add user authentication with email/password login, registration flow, and profile page showing user stats, achievements, and current brewery/trailer progress

pages.title: The Park Folk
pages.description: 12 unique comical trailer park characters with names, titles, quotes, bios, and personality traits. Tap to expand each character card.

pages.title: Social Sharing
pages.description: Share achievements and brewery progress with friends
pages.suggested_prompt: Add social sharing functionality allowing users to share their brewery builds, achievements, and progress screenshots to Facebook, Instagram, and Twitter

pages.title: Analytics Dashboard
pages.description: User engagement and gameplay statistics tracking
pages.suggested_prompt: Add analytics dashboard showing user engagement metrics, coin economy stats, popular activities, retention rates, and purchase conversion data

pages.title: Admin Panel
pages.description: Backend management for content, users, and monetization
pages.suggested_prompt: Add admin panel with user management, content moderation, coin economy balancing tools, purchase history, and ability to adjust pricing and rewards
